proposed_reference_geometry: Point inside original authored box is strict agreement, secondary Euclidean location errors within 0.025 and 0.05 of full image diagonal. Misses and non-proposals stay in all-clear denominators. Paired-only median explicitly identified. IoU on clear references treats missing geometry as zero. These are diagnostic tolerances, not evidence of a legal or feasible stop.
language_contrasts: Four predeclared pairs for each script, on distinct frames, compare both outputs against both intended points. A pair is distinguished only when both proposals lean closer to their own reference than the alternative. Rejected/missing/invalid count as failures.
clarification: Count status separately. Evaluate whether a question resolves the specific ambiguity using a labelled qualitative read, not similarity to a single sentence.
assistance: Model-only scores exclude passenger-selected boxes and downstream confirmation; scripted clarifying turns have their own case IDs.
